item.title: Alva Energy launches with $33 million to unlock 10 GWe of nuclear power
item.description: The company’s solution can deliver usable clean energy at scale from existing plants far faster and at much lower cost than new nuclear plants can be built – on a timeline and cost that is competitive with gas-fired generation.

item.title: Libya awards new oil, gas blocks to Chevron, Eni, others in first bidding round since 2007
item.description: The National Oil Corporation announced the winners of its first bidding round since 2007, allocating key acreage across the onshore Sirte and Murzuq basins and the offshore Sirte basin in the gas-rich Mediterranean.

item.title: Rain for Rent appoints Elliot Zimmer as Chief Executive Officer
item.description: On behalf of the Board of Directors and Company Shareholders, Rain for Rent announced Elliot Zimmer as Chief Executive Officer, succeeding Paul Harrington.

item.title: President Trump and Administrator Zeldin deliver the single largest deregulatory action in U.S. history
item.description: EPA's final rule saves taxpayers $1.3T by nixing the 2009 GHG Endangerment Finding and all federal GHG emission standards for vehicles and engines from MY 2012 through 2027 and beyond.

item.title: Mexican billionaire Slim's Grupo Carso confirms Pemex contract for Macavil gas field
item.description: In recent years, Slim has strengthened his presence in the local energy sector and his relationship with Pemex, adding to a business empire that also encompasses sectors as diverse as telecommunications, infrastructure and consumer goods.

item.title: Exxon's XTO unit seeks buyers for select Eagle Ford assets
item.description: The assets XTO is selling include over a thousand wells, some of which Exxon operates, and others in which it holds passive, or "non-operated" interests, and those from which it earns royalties, the sources said.

item.title: How Motiva drives capital project success through front end loading discipline
item.description: At the ECC Conference 2026, Jeremy Osterberger talks with Akshay Khanna, Project Manager for Major Capital Projects at Motiva, to discuss what truly defines success in large capital construction projects.

item.title: Cofimco Grand Opening
item.description: Cofimco celebrates the grand opening of its Houston facility with BIC Magazine, expanding U.S. manufacturing and growth.

item.title: Venezuela's PDVSA selling oil only to individually licensed companies
item.description: The general licenses are intended to exempt companies from U.S. sanctions on Venezuela's oil industry, which Washington has relaxed since capturing Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro last month.

item.title: 1 dead, 4 injured in Ardmore Valero refinery fire
item.description: At least four other workers remain hospitalized.
